title: ONS 2026 greenhouse gases by industry and gas revision QA controls

sources.title: Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas - current

facts.source_fact: ONS released the current gases-by-industry dataset on 5 June 2026.
The dataset includes carbon dioxide emissions by industry.
facts.expected_handling: Keep gas identity with each row.

facts.source_fact: The dataset includes methane emissions by industry.
facts.expected_handling: Do not combine methane mass with CO2 without an explicit CO2e conversion.

facts.source_fact: The dataset includes nitrous oxide emissions by industry.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve gas-specific units and conversion provenance.

facts.source_fact: The dataset includes hydrofluorocarbon emissions by industry.
The dataset includes perfluorocarbon emissions by industry.
The dataset includes sulphur hexafluoride emissions by industry.
The dataset includes nitrogen trifluoride emissions by industry.
The dataset also provides total greenhouse-gas emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not double count gas components and totals.

facts.source_fact: Detailed current data use SIC 2007 groups across roughly 130 industry categories.
The current edition covers 1990 to 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Do not extrapolate beyond the published period.

facts.source_fact: The current edition provides all economic sectors.
facts.expected_handling: Keep current and provisional coverage distinct.

facts.source_fact: The provisional edition provides top-level estimates.
ONS notes that estimates may be revised when further data become available.
ONS also revises data when methods or systems change.
ONS distinguishes planned revisions from genuine errors and corrections.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label scheduled revisions as errors.

facts.source_fact: A March 2026 correction fixed incorrect 2023 carbon-dioxide values for specified industries in an earlier file.
The dataset is part of the UK Environmental Accounts residence framework.
Environmental Accounts distinguish household emissions from individual industries in headline analysis.
facts.expected_handling: Do not silently allocate household emissions to industries.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 Environmental Accounts release is accredited official statistics.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable dataset, entity, geography or regulatory boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference period, release/update date and provisional/current/final status.
Carry source URL, publisher and calculation, reporting or quality-method provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert aggregate, facility, industry or scheme-level evidence into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
